subject: CryptoPkg: add AES_encrypt/AES_decrpyt for TPM reference library
reasons: This is a new API addition (adding AesEncrypt/AesDecrypt wrapper functions), not a transformation of existing code
Adding new function declarations, implementations, and protocol table entries cannot be expressed as a Coccinelle match-and-replace rule
Part of a series of TPM-related API additions, but each commit adds genuinely new code rather than transforming existing patterns
Coccinelle cannot generate new code where none existed before
